Aloo paratha (Hindi: आलू पराठा; "potato paratha") is a bread dish originating from the Indian subcontinent;

The recipe is one of the most popular breakfast dishes throughout western, central and northern regions of India as well as in Pakistan.Aloo parathas consist of unleavened dough stuffed with a spiced mixture of mashed potato, which is rolled out and cooked on a hot tawa with butter or ghee.[3] Aloo paratha is usually served with butter, chutney, curd or Indian pickles in different parts of northern and western India. Sometimes a glass of lassi is served along with it.

For easy audio and video instructions please watch the video, (Hindi Audio and English subtitles)

Ingredients (For 10 paratha)

3-4 Potatoes medium (boiled) 4 big cups wheat flour 1/2 small bowl clarified butter (Ghee)

****** To be mixed *******

  • 1 tbsp red chilli powder
  • Salt as per your taste
  • 1 tbsp fennel seeds
  • 1 tbsp Garam masala powder
  • 1 tbsp Coriander powder
  • 1 tbsp Amchur powder (Dry mango powder)

Cooking

First kneed the flour by slowly adding water as shown.

Keep adding water as much it is required for kneading. DON'T ADD water in ONE GO.

Add slowly as required. Add little salt and little clarified around 1-2 small tbsp butter(ghee) in the flour while kneading as shown.

Once done, cover the kneaded flour for 10-20 minutes. Peel the boiled potatoes and mash with hands to create stuffing. In mashed potatoes, add all the ingredients mentioned under 'To be mixed' and mix it all well.

Take some flour from the kneaded flour and create Paratha layer as shown in the video.

Put stuffing in paratha layer and close it tightly as shown in the video. Make sure it is closed well so that while creating paratha stuffing shouldn't come out.

Take some part of kneaded floor and create paratha layer slowly with the help of hand or roller pin. Put a flat frying pan on gas and sprinkle little clarified butter (ghee) on pan as shown. Once heated put paratha on the pan. Let it fry/roast till it start getting light brown from bottom.

Keep the flame on medium else paratha will burn. Once light brown from bottom flip the paratha slowly as shown.

Keep pressing slowly as shown so that it gets cooked from all side. Let it cook till other side (bottom now ) starts getting brown.

Now our first paratha is ready. Remove it from the pan. In nexr parathas slowly pour ghee (clarified butter) on sides as shown so that it gets cooked well from bottom with the help of ghee. Repeat rest of the steps to cook another paratha. Cook remaining parathas in similar way.

Serving

  • Transfer it to the serving plate.
  • Put some butter over cooked paratha to make it tastier.
  • Enjoy your Aloo paratha hot with curd, home made riata, pickle, chutney or sauce.
